1.SUBTITLE: PSTN, SIP Trunks, 4-Step Technical Pipeline, Platforms & Real Cost Breakdown — A complete guide.

2.SUBHEAD: 4-step loop: VAD -> STT -> LLM -> TTS in under 800ms latency.
2.BODY_TEXT: VAD detects speech, STT (Deepgram/Sarvam) converts voice to text, LLM (GPT-4o/Claude) calculates reply, TTS (ElevenLabs/Sarvam) speaks back.

3.BODY_TEXT: Use Virtual DIDs from Exotel, Vobiz (+91 India TRAI DLT compliant) or Twilio. SIP trunks bridge your internet AI server to mobile callers.

4.SUBHEAD: Launch client voice demos in 30 minutes without building infrastructure.
4.BODY_TEXT: Retell AI & Vapi offer production-grade WebRTC streams. Bolna AI is optimized natively for Hinglish & 10+ Indian regional languages.

5.BODY_TEXT: LiveKit Agents & Pipecat (Python) give 100% code ownership. Run real-time WebRTC streams with zero per-minute platform markups.

6.BODY_TEXT: At 10,000 call minutes/mo, No-Code costs ₹1.5 Lakhs while the Open-Source coding route costs under ₹35,000 plus ₹500 VPS hosting.
